name: Abacus Input
description: A number entered by sliding beads on a wooden abacus, one rod per digit, with each rod also a spin button you can type into.

props.name: value
props.description: The number (controlled). Setting it moves the beads.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a bead is clicked or let go, or a rod is changed from the keyboard.

props.name: rods
props.description: Number of rods, one per digit. The largest value is ten to this power, less one.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims the abacus and ignores input.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other div props are passed through.
